statements.statement: The procedure code billed was CPT 93229
The diagnosis codes submitted were I48.91, I34.0, and I49.5
The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and intermittent dizziness
There is concern for symptomatic atrial fibrillation and sick sinus syndrome
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate episodic symptoms with underlying arrhythmias
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to assess the efficacy of current rate control management
The denial reason code was CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or authorization prior to the service date
